customManagers.description: KubeVirt operator: bump every virt-operator image ref AND the KUBEVIRT_VERSION env together
CDI operator: bump every cdi-* image ref AND the OPERATOR_VERSION env together

packageRules.description: Immich images - group server and ML together
Authentik server + proxy outpost must run the same version - group them into one PR so they never split (a newer proxy outrunning the server breaks SSO).

Group all Flux pieces into one PR: the flux2 distribution version (flux manager updates the gotk-components version comment) and the six controller images (kubernetes manager bumps them in gotk-components). They are complementary, not redundant - grouping keeps them coordinated instead of 7 overlapping PRs.
forgejo-runner: pin to the Forgejo registry; Renovate inferred an extra registry and failed the docker token lookup
cilium: single registryUrl (chart defined per-cluster against the same helm repo) to avoid the duplicate-registryUrl warning

KubeVirt & CDI operator versions are owned by the customManagers above (image + every env value move as one). Disable the kubernetes manager on these files so it cannot open a partial-update PR that bumps only image: and breaks the operator.

CloudNativePG Postgres engine MAJOR upgrades are disruptive and not trivially reversible. Hold them behind explicit Dependency Dashboard approval so they never open/merge unattended; minor and patch still flow as normal PRs.
